gsc_note: GSC API was not available. Decisions use Google referrer + Googlebot HTML hits from the latest Baota access-log sample (~1000 lines). Threshold: gref>=10 keep a 301; otherwise 410. Cloudflare robots/sitemap edge cache (max-age=3600) can hide origin updates until TTL; origin Cache-Control is no-cache. Owner should remove sitemap-products.xml in GSC after cache expires.

indie_notes.vigorspreadsheet.com: HTTP and HTTPS each had location / try_files; patcher must replace every block, not only the first.
indie_notes.pantherbuy.net: Apex HTTPS 301'd to www; www is 410. Harden apex to 410 so Google does not follow a 301 into Gone.

usfans.note: Same agent, different countries — keep independent local sites. Do not 301 uk/nl/co.uk onto .net.

w2c.note: Homepages were identical clones branded as w2cReps / w2crep.org.

product_noindex.action: X-Robots-Tag noindex,follow on /product/; empty sitemap-products.xml; drop product URLs from sitemap.xml and robots.txt. Pages stay crawlable so Google can drop them from the index.

indie.independent_note: These are separate shopping-agent hubs. Do not 301 them to w2clinks.com (doorway). Redesign: scripts/indie_agent_redesign.py — unique copy, collapsed cookie-cutter URLs, no shared catalog.
